description.value:
Generally mounted on the shoulder, this popup launcher fires flechettes. The flechette launcher holds six cartridges of standard projectile ammunition. Reloading it is a laborious process that can be done only during your daily preparations.

Activate—Barrage 3 (manipulate)

Requirements The flechette launcher is loaded with at least one cartridge

Effect You fire any number of cartridges. Each cartridge hits automatically, dealing @Damage[(1d4+1)[piercing]] damage to a creature within 120 feet. If multiple flechettes hit the same target, combine the damage before applying resistances, weaknesses, and so on.
